{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}What I don't get, maaannn,
are people that bring
food to the beach.
They're missing out on
the best part--fishy,
squishy scallops!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Mida ma ei mõista, meeees,
on inimesed, kes toovad
randa toitu.
Nad jätavad ilma parimast
osast – kalastest,
limastest kammkarpidest!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Beaches, maaannn. People do
the weirdest things at
them.
I saw these people bring an
umbrella, but it wasn't
even raining, maaannn.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Rannad, meeees. Inimesed
teevad seal kõige
veidramaid asju.
Nägin, kuidas need inimesed
tõid vihmavarju, aga isegi
ei sadanud, meeees.

{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Vaalad, meeees. Kuidas
nad saavad kõhu täis
pisikesest krillist?
Kui mina oleksin vaal, ma
sööksin, nagu, allveelaevu
või midagi, meeees.

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}People do the weirdest
things at the beach,
maaannn.
I saw this guy picking up
something heavy and putting
it back down again.
It's like he'd lift it and
then forget what he was
supposed to do with it.
He'd just put it down again!{01 00 00 05 00}
Maaannn, he must have done
that a hundred times.

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Inimesed teevad rannas
kõige veidramaid asju,
meeees.
Nägin, kuidas üks tüüp
tõstis midagi rasket üles
ja pani selle jälle maha.
Nagu ta tõstaks selle ja
unustaks siis, mida ta
pidi sellega tegema.
Ta pani selle jälle maha!{01 00 00 05 00}
Meeees, ta tegi seda
vist sada korda.

{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}If goldfish grow bigger
depending on, like, how much
space they have, maaannn...
What would happen if you
let a mutant sea goldfish
into the ocean?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Kui kuldkalad kasvavad
suuremaks olenevalt, nagu,
sellest, kui palju ruumi neil
on, meeees... Mis juhtuks,
kui sa laseksid mutantse
merekuldkala ookeani?

{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Vahel pead sa lauad
ümber pöörama, meeees,
lihtsalt et asja vürtsitada.
Nagu, vahel panen ma
viineri õnge otsa ja
püüan inimesi.

{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Meeees, vahel peidan ma end
kivide taha ja sosistan
inimestele veidrat
filosoofiat. Tead, nagu, et
nende meelt avardada.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}People, maaannn. They're
always taking a shower
after swimming in the sea.
Don't they know they can
save the salt crusts
for their dinner, maaannn?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Inimesed, meeees. Nad
käivad alati duši all
pärast meres ujumist.
Kas nad ei tea, et võiksid
soolakoorikud õhtusöögiks
alles hoida, meeees?

{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}People, maaannn. They do
the weirdest stuff at the
beach.
I saw this couple once using
these paddles that whack
this poor little ball.
What kind of psychos do
that, maaannn?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Inimesed, meeees. Nad
teevad rannas kõige
veidramat kraami.
Nägin kord üht paari, kes
kasutas neid reketeid, mis
taovad seda vaest pallikest.
Mis sorti hullud seda
teevad, meeees?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Maaann, if you dumped
a million oranges into a
deep-sea trench...
Would it turn the ocean
into a giant sea of
freshly squeezed OJ?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Meees, kui sa kallaksid
miljon apelsini
sügavasse süvikusse...
Kas ookean muutuks
hiiglaslikuks värskelt
pressitud mahlameres?

{07 16 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{01 00 00 01 00}.{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0f 00}

{ff 00 00 02}{07 16 00}Mis siis, kui karbid on
universumi kõige targemad
olendid, meeees?
Ja nad lihtsalt mõtlevad
liiga kõvasti, et midagi
öelda.{01 00 00 0a 00} Oh, meeeees.
